title: Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - Code injection via calculation formulas in Visforms extension 1.0.0-5.6.4,…
description: A critical code injection vulnerability exists in the Joomla Visforms extension versions 1.0.0 through 5.6.4 and 6.0.0 through 6.2.1. The vulnerability arises because calculation field formulas are executed using PHP eval() without proper validation, allowing backend users with field edit permissions to execute arbitrary PHP code.
